before.name: Dominic D. Brown
before.description: Dominic D. Brown, 18, of Knoxville, TN was charged with riots and civil disorder after posting profane Snapchat messages calling for a riot and after he was observed picking up a trash can lid filled with an unclear liquid and striking an officer who was sitting in a vehicle. Sentenced to 24 months federal prison plus a $100 fine.
